subject: Finlytics — evaluation kickoff & next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finlytics.ai>, Lara Mitchell <lara.mitchell@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 16:14:00 +0000
Subject: Finlytics — evaluation kickoff & next steps

Hi Samir / Lara —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Goal: improve customer support triage and routing latency using embeddings + reranking for ticket summarization.
- Success criteria you called out: 25% lower time-to-first-meaningful-action and 15% improvement in top-1 rerank accuracy on the 2k historical prompt set.
- Data note: you’ll run the eval on a redacted subset of production tickets (PII removed). Procurement and legal are OK with the minimal data share for an evaluation.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kickoff evaluation call (30–45m) to align trial plan, success criteria, and prompt set/evals
2) Redwood to deliver a one-page evaluation plan and a sample prompt set for your review
3) Set up a short technical deep-dive with your ML lead if needed during the trial

Proposed times for the kickoff (your timezone):
- Wed Nov 10 — 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed Nov 10 — 13:00–13:45 PT
- Thu Nov 11 — 11:00–11:45 PT

I attached a draft evaluation plan for context. If those times don’t work, share a couple alternatives and we’ll align. I’ll loop in Connor to schedule the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Finlytics-eval-plan-v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Finlytics — evaluation kickoff & next steps

Thanks Neha — appreciate the clear recap. Wed Nov 10 at 13:00 PT works best for me and Lara.

One ask: can you invite our ML lead, Evan Park (evan.park@finlytics.ai)? He’ll want to review the model variants and runtime requirements during the kickoff. Also, procurement copied for any SSO/KMS questions later.

We’re excited to see the one-pager and the sample prompts — that will help us scope the first run.

—Samir
Head of Product, Finlytics
